name: Global Fund for Coral Reefs (GFCR UN Fund)
summary: UN-hosted coalition fund that channels grants, technical assistance and concessional finance through on-site partners to reef-positive businesses and finance mechanisms protecting climate-resilient coral reefs in developing countries.

geography.label: More than 20 coral nations in Latin America and the Caribbean, Africa, the Middle East, Asia and the Pacific Islands

geography.quote: Targeting coral refugia, GFCR's portfolio spans more than 20 coral nations, ranging from Latin America and the Caribbean, to Africa and the Middle East, to Asia and the Pacific Islands.

access.quote: The GFCR UN Fund, managed by a UN Global Team, provides grants, technical assistance, and concessional finance through GFCR's on-site partners
